title: See how much your weight changed
summary: Body history now shows how much you gained or lost beside each arrow, in the Daily, Avg Week and Avg Monthly views.
changes: Each up or down arrow in Body history now shows the amount gained or lost compared with the row below, such as ↓ 0.5.
Daily compares with your previous check-in; Avg Week and Avg Monthly compare with the previous week or month that has check-ins.
Amounts use your weight unit and match the rounded weights shown, so they add up when you compare two rows.

image.alt: Avg Monthly bodyweight history with a green down arrow and the amount lost beside each month, such as 2.2 and 0.5.
